basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 1.' and it opens 'Vers. 1. Diebus novissimis. Hoc dicendo ostendit se prophetice locuturum. Licet enim haec'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 1. Diebus novissimis. Hoc dicendo ostendit se prophetice locuturum. Licet enim haec verba, quibus filiis benedixit, ad divisionem possessionis quam acceperunt in terra Chanaan, pertineant, specialiter tamen ad Christum, qui novissimo saeculi tempore incarnatus est, referenda sunt.
